column1: # The two sources this engine's committed answers come from.
# default judges databricks/parser/testdata/compat.tsv through Apache Spark
# container image. SqlBaseParser.g4 and SqlBaseLexer.g4 beside this file are
# Apache Spark's official ANTLR 4 SQL grammar from the same release tag v4.0.5
# driver is the workspace this engine's driver tapes come from. Databricks is
# an account service: there is no image and no container, so image names the
# workspace host, digest is the SHA-256 of what SELECT VERSION() answered, and
# the source tag names the SQL release, the SQL warehouse and the catalog the
# tests record against. The token is never part of a pin.
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag, judge revision
